articles.title: Crypto trading firm FalconX confidentially files with SEC for IPO, hires bankers
articles.snippet: FalconX has hired Cantor and other bankers to advise on a potential IPO and confidentially filed draft paperwork with the SEC, though the listing is not expected until later this year amid volatile market conditions.

articles.title: Samsung units to buy $408 million stake in South Korea’s biggest crypto exchange
articles.snippet: Samsung Securities is set to take a 2% stake in Dunamu, worth over $200 million, from affiliates of technology conglomerate Kakao.

articles.title: CFTC seeks to reverse settlement deal with Gemini
articles.snippet: The CFTC claimed that its settled complaint filed under the Biden administration relied heavily on a whistleblower’s allegations that Gemini inflated trading activity to distort user demand.

articles.title: This AI Compressed 'All Human Cooking' Into 2 Megabytes
articles.snippet: A London startup trained an AI on 4.1 million recipes across seven languages—and the whole thing is smaller than a song file.

articles.title: CFTC, Gemini File Joint Motion to Reverse $5M Settlement
articles.snippet: The regulator filed alongside the crypto exchange to undo a 2025 consent order it now says "should not have been filed."
